<p>最近折腾了一个项目，看名字就是ai智能体了，<a href="https://github.com/liuzhixin405/cagentcli" rel="noopener nofollow">liuzhixin405/cagentcli</a>&nbsp;借鉴了claude-code和hermes的设计理念。目前只是通过deepseek的api来做的测试，本人只是微测试，开发团队那就是<br>deepseek,hermes,claude,gpt一众大佬了。个人精力有限，上线bug，用户体验问题肯定少不了，望多担待或者一起修复。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202605/1099890-20260530130221578-1046443143.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;临近上线还是bug不断，让它自己来修。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202605/1099890-20260530130527553-1961206379.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>该项目源码就不一一展示了，特征如下：</p>

<p>&nbsp;鉴于golang语言的简介，实现起来非常简单，结构也非常明了，一看就知道实现了哪些功能。</p>

<p>&nbsp;以下纯属项目介绍：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># agentgo 运行时架构深度解析：一个 Go AI 编程助手的核心引擎设计

</span>&gt; 本文从代码层面剖析 agentgo 的运行时机制——Tool-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Calling 循环、权限沙箱、护栏防循环、Git 检查点、记忆梦境整理、子代理架构等核心子系统。

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>. 先看全貌：<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">25</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 个内部包，最小依赖

agentgo 的 `</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span>/` 目录下挂着 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">25</span>+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 个包，但 `go.mod` 只有两个外部依赖：

```
module github.com</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">agentgo
go </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.24</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
require golang.org</span>/x/term v0.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">29.0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
require golang.org</span>/x/sys v0.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30.0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```

`term` 用于终端原始模式（REPL 输入），`sys` 是 `term` 的传递依赖。没有 ORM、没有 Web 框架、没有 JSON schema 库——</span>**一切从零手写**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">。

这个极简依赖策略带来了一个关键收益：</span>**安全审计面积极小**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">。你可以在一小时内 review 完所有第三方代码。

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 核心引擎循环：`Engine.RunMessageWithStream`

一切从 `engine.go` 的 `RunMessageWithStream` 开始。这是整个运行时的心脏，约 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">200</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 行实现了一个完整的 Agentic Loop：

```go
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> iter := <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; iter &lt; MaxIterations; iter++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 检查 context 取消（Ctrl+C 中断）</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> ctx.Err() != nil { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, ctx.Err() }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 构建请求：系统提示词 + 历史消息 + 工具定义</span>
    req :=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> api.ChatRequest{
        Model:      e.config.Model,
        Messages:   reqMessages,
        SystemBase: sp,
        Tools:      toolDefs,
        MaxTokens:  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">64000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 调用 LLM（支持流式 + 非流式两种路径）</span>
    resp, err = e.provider.ChatStream(ctx, req, onDelta) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 或 Chat()

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 更新费用追踪</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    e.costTracker.AddDetailed(e.config.Model, resp.InputTokens, resp.OutputTokens, ...)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5. 处理截断响应（max_tokens stop reason → 注入续写提示）</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> resp.StopReason == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">max_tokens</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> &amp;&amp; len(resp.ToolCalls) == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        e.messages </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> append(e.messages, 
            api.Message{Role: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Content: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[system: previous response was truncated...]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">})
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 6. 无工具调用 → 对话结束，返回</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> len(resp.ToolCalls) == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        e.runTurnEndPipeline() </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 触发后台任务</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> resp.Content, nil
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 7. 执行工具调用（支持并行）
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ...

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 8. 护栏检查 + 熔断器
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ...

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 9. 上下文压缩检查</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> e.totalTokens &gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CompactTokenThreshold {
        e.Compact(ctx)
    }
}
```

### 设计要点：

</span>**a) `MaxIterations = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">200</span>` 上限保护**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

每一轮对话最多执行 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">200</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 次 LLM 调用。超过上限直接报错退出，防止无限循环烧钱。

</span>**b) 截断续写机制**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

LLM 可能在生成到一半时达到 max_tokens 上限，此时如果只是文本截断（没有完整的 tool_call），引擎会自动注入一条 system 消息让模型继续：

```go
e.messages </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> append(e.messages, api.Message{
    Role: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, 
    Content: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[system: your previous response was truncated due to length. Please continue, writing one file at a time.]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
})
```

</span>**c) `ctx.Err()` 快速退出**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

每次迭代开始时第一件事就是检查 context——如果用户按了 Ctrl</span>+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">C，立即退出而非继续消耗 API 调用。

</span>**d) `CompactTokenThreshold = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">64000</span>`**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

当累计 token 超过 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">64000</span> 且已执行 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 次迭代时，自动触发上下文压缩。

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 权限系统：三层决策链

agentgo 的权限模型不是简单的「允许</span>/拒绝」二元开关，而是一条**三层决策链**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：

```go
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第一层：工具自身声明权限意向</span>
toolDecision :=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> t.CheckPermissions(tc.Input, tctx)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第二层：权限管理器综合判断</span>
decision, reason :=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.perm.Check(tc.Name, tc.Input, mapToolDecision(toolDecision.Decision))

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第三层：用户交互确认</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> decision ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> permission.DAsk {
    approved :</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.PermissionPrompt(tc.Name, tc.Input, reason)
}
```

### 权限管理器核心逻辑 (`permission</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">permission.go`):

```go
func (m </span>*Manager) Check(toolName <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, toolInput map[<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>]any, defaultDecision Decision) (Decision, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. Deny 规则优先：黑名单中的操作直接拒绝</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> _, r :=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> range m.deny {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> matchRule(r, toolName, toolInput) { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> DDeny, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">denied by policy rule</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. Bypass 模式：完全绕过</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> m.mode == Bypass &amp;&amp; m.bypassAvailable { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> DBypass, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bypass mode</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. Allow 规则：白名单放行</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> _, r := range m.allow { ... <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DAllow }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. Ask 规则：需要确认</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> _, r := range m.ask { ... <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DAsk }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5. 模式默认行为</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">switch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> m.mode {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> Auto:  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 安全工具自动放行，危险工具仍需确认</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> Plan:  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 只读工具放行，写操作直接拒绝</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span>:    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> default 模式：尊重工具自身声明</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
}
```

四种模式的行为矩阵：


</span>| 模式      | 只读工具 (read/grep/glob) | 写文件 (write/edit) | 执行命令 (bash) | 危险命令 (rm -rf) |
| --------- | ------------------------- | ------------------- | --------------- | ----------------- |
| `<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span>` | ✅ 自动                   | ⚠️ 询问           | ⚠️ 询问       | ❌ 阻断           |
| `plan`    | ✅ 自动                   | ❌ 拒绝             | ❌ 拒绝         | ❌ 阻断           |
| `auto`    | ✅ 自动                   | ✅ 自动             | ⚠️ 询问       | ❌ 阻断           |
| `bypass`  | ✅ 自动                   | ✅ 自动             | ✅ 自动         | ✅ 自动           |<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

其中「危险命令」由 `classifier.Classify(cmd)` 判定（`permission</span>/classifier.go`），独立于模式设置——**任何模式都阻止 `rm -rf /`、`format c:` 这类操作**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">。

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 护栏系统：防死循环的三路检测器

`guardrail</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">guardrail.go` 实现了一个轻量级的工具调用异常检测器，在每次工具执行前进行拦截：

```go
type Tracker </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    exactFailures   map[signature]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 相同工具+参数连续失败次数</span>
    sameToolFails   map[<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>]<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>       <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 同一工具名连续失败次数</span>
    idempotentSeen  map[signature]<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 只读工具上次返回结果哈希</span>
    idempotentCount map[signature]<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 相同结果连续返回次数</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
```

### 三路检测逻辑：

</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>. **精确失败检测**：同一工具 + 同一参数连续失败 ≥ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> 次 → **Block**，<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请换一种方法</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>. **工具级失败检测**：同一工具连续失败 ≥ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span> 次 → **Block**，<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">尝试其他工具</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>. **只读无进展检测**：`read`/`grep`/`glob`/`webfetch` 返回相同结果 ≥ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> 次 → **Block**，<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">无需重复调用</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

签名生成使用SHA256取前8位：

```go
func makeSignature(name </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, args map[<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]any) signature {
    data, _ :</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> json.Marshal(args)
    h :</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sha256.Sum256(data)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> signature{Name: name, ArgsHash: hex.EncodeToString(h[:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])}
}
```

此外，引擎层还有一个</span>**熔断器**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">（Circuit Breaker）：

```go
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> allFailed &amp;&amp; len(results) &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    e.consecutiveErrors</span>++
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> e.consecutiveErrors &gt;= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 注入 system 消息引导模型换方案</span>
        e.messages =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> append(e.messages, api.Message{
            Role: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            Content: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[system: The last 3+ tool calls all failed. Please try a different approach...]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        })
    }
}
```

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. Git 检查点：用 Bare Repo 实现无侵入快照

`checkpoint</span>/checkpoint.go` 是一个精巧的设计——它在 `~/.agentgo/checkpoints/store` 下初始化一个 **bare Git 仓库**，用一个 **临时 index 文件**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 来做快照，完全不污染工作目录的 `.git`：

```go
env :</span>= []<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">GIT_DIR=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> + m.storeDir,      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 独立的 bare repo</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">GIT_WORK_TREE=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> + m.workDir,  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 指向实际工作目录</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">GIT_INDEX_FILE=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> + indexFile, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 临时索引，不影响真实 git 状态</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
```

每个工作目录通过 SHA256 哈希映射到独立的 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：

```go
h :</span>= sha256.Sum256([]<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(workDir))
refName :</span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">refs/agentgo/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> + hex.EncodeToString(h[:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])
```

自动排除大文件和构建产物：

```go
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> excludePatterns = []<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">node_modules</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.git</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.venv</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">__pycache__</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">*.exe</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">*.dll</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">*.so</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">*.dylib</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">target/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">dist/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">build/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.next/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
}
```

在引擎中，写文件和编辑文件之前自动创建检查点：

```go
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> e.checkpointMgr != nil &amp;&amp; (tc.Name == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">write</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> || tc.Name == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">edit</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> || tc.Name == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bash</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
    e.checkpointMgr.Create(tc.Name </span>+ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> shortPath(tc.Input))
}
```

用户可以用 `</span>/undo` 回退，用 `/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">checkpoints` 查看历史。

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 多供应商抽象：一个 Interface，两种实现

`api</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">provider.go` 定义了一个统一的 `Provider` 接口：

```go
type Provider </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    Name() </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    DisplayName() </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    Chat(ctx context.Context, req ChatRequest) (</span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ChatResponse, error)
    ChatStream(ctx context.Context, req ChatRequest, handler StreamHandler) (</span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ChatResponse, error)
    Validate() error
}
```

实际上只有两个具体实现：

</span>- **`anthropicProvider`**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> — 调用 Anthropic Messages API
</span>- **`openAICompatProvider`** — 覆盖所有 OpenAI-compatible API（DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi、Qwen、Groq 等 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span>+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 个供应商）

`DetectProvider` 根据模型名自动推断：

```go
func DetectProvider(model </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, cfg ProviderConfig) Provider {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> cfg.Name != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span> { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> NewProvider(cfg) }        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用户指定</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> containsAny(model, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">deepseek</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) { ... }             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模型名包含 deepseek</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> containsAny(model, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">gpt-</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">o1-</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">o3-</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">o4-</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) { ... }  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> OpenAI 系列</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> newAnthropicProvider(cfg)                     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 默认走 Anthropic</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
```

### 密钥池：多 Key 轮转 </span>+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 自动冷却

`api</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">keypool.go` 实现了一个带健康状态的 API Key 池：

```go
type PoolKey </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    Key       </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    Status    KeyStatus   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> KeyOK | KeyExhausted | KeyDead</span>
    CoolUntil time.Time   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 冷却到期时间</span>
    UseCount  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    LastError </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}
```

</span>- Round-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">robin 轮转取 key
</span>- 收到 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">429</span> (Rate Limit) → 自动标记 `KeyExhausted` +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 设定冷却时间
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 冷却期满自动复活
</span>- 认证失败 (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">401</span>/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">403</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) → 标记 `KeyDead`，不再使用
</span>- `/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ratelimit` 命令可查看当前密钥池健康状态

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span>. 记忆系统：磁盘文件 + XML 注入 +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 梦境整理

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6.1</span> 存储层 (`memory/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">store.go`)

记忆以</span>**独立文件**存储在 `~/.agentgo/memory/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">` 目录，同时自动加载工作目录下的 `CLAUDE.md`：

```go
func (s </span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Store) All() []Entry {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 读取 ~/.agentgo/memory/ 下所有文件
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 读取项目根目录的 CLAUDE.md
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 读取 .claude/CLAUDE.md（如有）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
```

容量限制：

</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 单个条目 ≤ 25KB
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 总容量 ≤ 100KB
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 自动 truncation

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6.2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 注入到 System Prompt

记忆内容以 XML 格式注入到系统提示词中，放在 `</span>&lt;user_memories&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">` 标签内：

```xml
</span>&lt;user_memories&gt;
&lt;memory&gt;
&lt;name&gt;environment.md&lt;/name&gt;
&lt;content&gt;...&lt;/content&gt;
&lt;/memory&gt;
&lt;/user_memories&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```

带 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 秒 TTL 的缓存：

```go
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> s.cachedAll != nil &amp;&amp; time.Since(s.cacheTime) &lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s.cacheTTL {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> s.cachedAll  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 避免每次构建 system prompt 都读磁盘</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
```

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6.3</span> Dream 梦境整理 (`dream/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dream.go`)

这是一个</span>**后台运行的独立 LLM 代理**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，专门负责记忆文件的增删改和整理。

触发门控（三重检查）：

```
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 时间门控：距上次整理 ≥ MinHours 小时（默认 24h）
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>. 扫描节流：两次扫描间隔 ≥ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 分钟（避免高频检查）
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>. 会话门控：新会话数 ≥ MinSessions（默认 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 个）
```

触发后独立运行一个 Tool</span>-Calling 循环（最多 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 次迭代），只授予受限工具：

```
允许：bash(ls</span>/find/grep/cat/stat/wc/head/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tail), read, write, edit, glob, grep
禁止：任何写命令（rm</span>/mv/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">cp）、网络请求
```

且 `write`</span>/`edit` 被限制只能操作 `~/.agentgo/memory/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">` 目录：

```go
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">isInsideMemoryDir(absPath, r.memoryRoot) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Error: dream mode can only write to memory directory</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}
```

加锁机制防止多个 agentgo 进程同时运行 dream：

```go
priorMtime, acquired, err :</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TryAcquireConsolidationLock()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> !acquired { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }
defer RollbackConsolidationLock(task.PriorMtime) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 失败回滚</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">```

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 并行工具执行：区分并发安全与串行

当 LLM 返回多个 tool_call 时，引擎自动并行执行并发安全的工具：

```go
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> len(resp.ToolCalls) &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> wg sync.WaitGroup
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i, tc :=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> range resp.ToolCalls {
        t, _ :</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.registry.Find(tc.Name)
        safe :</span>= t != nil &amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> t.Def().IsConcurrencySafe

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> write/edit 到不同文件也可以并行</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> !safe &amp;&amp; (tc.Name == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">write</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> || tc.Name == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">edit</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> fp, ok := tc.Input[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">filePath</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>].(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>); ok &amp;&amp; fp != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">serialFilePaths[fp] {
                    serialFilePaths[fp] </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                    safe </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                }
            }
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> safe {
            wg.Add(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            go func(idx </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, tcall api.ToolCall) {
                defer wg.Done()
                defer func() {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> r := recover(); r !=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> nil {
                        results[idx] </span>= toolResult{...Error: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tool panicked: ...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
                    }
                }()
                results[idx] </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> toolResult{...e.executeTool(ctx, tcall)}
            }(i, tc)
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            results[i] </span>= toolResult{...e.executeTool(ctx, tc)}  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 串行</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
    }
    wg.Wait()
}
```

关键设计：

</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 每个并行 goroutine 包裹 `recover()` 防止 panic 导致进程崩溃
</span>- `write`/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`edit` 到不同文件路径视为安全的并发操作
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `bash` 命令默认串行（有副作用）

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 上下文窗口管理：三级压缩策略

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8.1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 工具输出自适应截断

不同工具的输出采用不同的 token 上限：

```go
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">switch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tc.Name {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">read</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">grep</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    maxTokens </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6000</span>  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 源代码上下文更有价值</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bash</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    maxTokens </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3000</span>  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 构建/测试输出通常重复</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">webfetch</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    maxTokens </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3000</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    maxTokens </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}
```

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8.2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 旧工具结果瘦身

`trimOldToolResults` 将早期的 verbose 工具输出替换为一行摘要：

```go
m.Content </span>= fmt.Sprintf(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[%s] %s (%d chars原始输出已压缩)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, m.Name, firstLine, len(m.Content))
```

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8.3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 全量压缩 (`Compact`)

当 token 超过 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">64000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 时，调用 LLM 对早期对话进行摘要，保留最近的消息段：

```go
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 结构: [第一条用户消息] + [LLM 摘要] + [最近消息]</span>
newMsgs := make([]api.Message, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">keepTail)
newMsgs </span>= append(newMsgs, e.messages[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>])          <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第一个 user 消息</span>
newMsgs =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> append(newMsgs, api.Message{
    Role: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    Content: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[Context Summary]\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> compactResp.Content,
})
newMsgs </span>= append(newMsgs, e.messages[splitIdx:]...)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 保留尾部</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">```

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9</span>. Turn-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">End Pipeline：后台任务流水线

每轮对话结束后，`runTurnEndPipeline` 启动五个并行的后台 goroutine：

```go
func (e </span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Engine) runTurnEndPipeline() {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 会话笔记落盘（无 API 开销）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    go func() { e.sessionNotes.Flush() }()

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. Dream 梦境整理检查（条件触发）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    go func() { e.dreamRunner.ExecuteAutoDream(context.Background()) }()

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 后台回顾学习</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    go func() { e.backgroundReview() }()

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> !e.autoExtract { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 记忆提取（调用 LLM 从对话中提取关键信息）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    go func() { e.extractRunner.Extract(context.Background(), msgs) }()

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5. 后续建议生成（带 5 秒超时）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    go func() {
        ctx, cancel :</span>= context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">time.Second)
        defer cancel()
        sug :</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.suggestRunner.Generate(ctx, msgs)
        e.lastSuggestions </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sug
    }()
}
```

所有 goroutine 都包裹了 `recover()`，保证一个后台 panic 不会炸掉主进程。

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 子代理系统：递归的引擎实例化

`agent</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">runner.go` 实现了子代理调度器：

```go
func (r </span>*Runner) Run(ctx context.Context, name <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, task <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>) (*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">api.AgentRunResult, error) {
    def :</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> r.defs[name]
    agentTools :</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> r.filterTools(def.Tools)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建独立的 Engine 实例</span>
    eng, _ :=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> engine.New(engine.Config{
        Model:          def.Model,
        PermissionMode: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">auto</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 子代理默认 auto 模式</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        Tools:          agentTools,
        Provider:       r.config.Provider,
    })

    eng.SetSystemOverride(strings.Join([]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
        fmt.Sprintf(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[Sub-agent: %s]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, def.Name),
        def.Description,
        def.Prompt,
    }, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))

    output, err :</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> eng.Run(ctx, task)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> &amp;api.AgentRunResult{Output: output, Cost: ..., Success: err ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> nil}
}
```

预定义了五种子代理类型：

</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `general` — 通用任务
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `explore` — 代码探索
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `plan` — 方案设计
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `review` — 代码审查
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `test` — 测试编写

每个子代理是</span>**全新的 Engine 实例**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，有自己的消息历史、费用追踪和工具集。这相当于在主会话中 fork 出一个隔离的沙箱执行环境。

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">11</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 费用追踪：精算到 Token 级别

`cost</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tracker.go` 硬编码了主流模型的实时价格：

```go
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> Prices = map[<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]Price{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">claude-sonnet-4-20250514</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: {Input: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3.0</span>, Output: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15.0</span>},     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> $3/$15 per 1M tokens</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">deepseek-v4-pro</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>:          {Input: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.435</span>, Output: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.87</span>},   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> $0.435/$0.87</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">gpt-4o</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>:                   {Input: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2.5</span>, Output: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ...</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
```

支持 Anthropic 的 Prompt Cache 分层计费：

```go
t.TotalCost </span>+= (float64(cacheMiss)/1e6)*p.Input +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
               (float64(cacheHit)</span>/1e6)*p.InputCacheHit +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
               (float64(output)</span>/1e6)*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">p.Output
```

每次 API 调用后更新，`OverBudget()` 检查在下一轮迭代前生效：

```go
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.costTracker.OverBudget() {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>, fmt.Errorf(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">budget exceeded: %s</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, e.costTracker.Summary())
}
```

持久化的 `CostHistory` 提供 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">24</span> 小时、<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 天、累计统计。

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 结语

agentgo 的核心引擎设计体现了一种 </span>**「深度防御 + 激进优化」**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 的哲学：

</span>- **深度防御**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：Classifier → Permission Manager → Guardrail → Circuit Breaker → MaxIterations，五层保护
</span>- **激进优化**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：并行工具执行、自适应截断、多级压缩、Prompt 缓存
</span>- **最小依赖**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：两个外部包，一切从零手写

它证明了一件事：用 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">000</span> 行 Go 代码 +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 两个第三方依赖，完全可以构建出一个功能不输于任何竞品的 AI 编程助手运行时。

</span>---</pre>
</div>
